signals.signal: Re-pull of Postbank's own branch/ATM locator (server-rendered, machine-readable data-types flags) on 27/08/2026 returns 668 location records: 501 carrying an ATM, of which only 226 are flagged 'isATMWithDeposit' (Bulgarian label: 'Банкомат с депозитна функция') — leaving 275 cash-out-only ATM sites (54.9% of the ATM estate). Branch-side: 167 branches, 154 of them with a self-service zone ('isSelfServiceZone'), 137 of those open 24/7 ('isSSZ24H'), 71 specialised centres, 50 priority desks. Baseline at 30/07/2026 was 498 ATM locations / 225 deposit-capable, so the estate grew by 3 ATM sites and 1 deposit-capable site in four weeks.
signals.source_name: Postbank — Branch network and contacts locator (content.postbank.bg/Contacts/Network)
signals.implies: 275 cash-out-only ATMs is the single largest quantified cash-automation white space at this bank: each is a candidate for replacement or upgrade to a deposit-accepting or recycling machine now that the euro changeover is finished and cash-handling cost is the remaining lever. Directly Printec ATM/self-service + cash automation/recyclers + managed services. The 154 self-service zones (137 of them 24/7) are the physical estate those machines sit in.
signals.likelihood: Deposit-capable share is creeping up ~1 site/month organically; a step change needs a fleet programme, which is plausible within 6-12 months given the stated network-expansion plan
signals.followup: Re-pull this locator monthly and track the isATMWithDeposit count as the leading indicator of a recycler tender. Establish the incumbent ATM vendor and the service contract renewal date.

signals.signal: In its 35th-anniversary rebrand announcement Postbank stated that Postbank NEXT is a NETWORK of next-generation offices ('мрежа от ново поколение офиси Postbank NEXT') integrating digital technology, self-service zones and video consultation, and explicitly listed forthcoming 'expansion of the office network' ('разширяване на офис мрежата') alongside new investment products and a rolling series of innovations over the coming months. The same release confirms already-delivered pieces: a new-generation front-office system, a NEW CARD PLATFORM, over 100 deployed AI solutions, and completed migration of systems to the euro.
signals.implies: Counter-trend for CEE: Postbank is EXPANDING, not shrinking, its physical network, and every new office is specified with a self-service zone and video consultation. That converts branch expansion directly into self-service terminal demand. The new card platform is a separate hook for HSM/security and transaction monitoring; the front-office system replacement signals an integration window that is still open.
signals.likelihood: High — expansion stated as an announced roadmap item for the following months
signals.followup: Get the Postbank NEXT rollout count and site pipeline for 2027, and the equipment specification per zone. Identify the front-office and card-platform vendors already inside.

signals.signal: Postbank opened the first 'Postbank Next' office, at the XOPark retail park, built around five named zones: an Express Banking Digital Zone (fully independent execution of standard operations), a flexible Digital Zone for real-time demos, an Interactive educational zone, an Assisted zone for personal advisory, and a Video-consultation zone giving remote access to specialists for complex products. Journey design: greeter first, self-service second, human advisor only on need.
signals.implies: This is the replicable template behind the network-expansion plan. Each unit needs cash-in/cash-out recyclers plus cashless kiosks, video-teller infrastructure and a managed-services wrap. Printec self-service, cash automation and managed services map one-to-one.
signals.likelihood: High that further Next-format offices follow within 12 months
signals.followup: Establish which vendor supplied the XOPark self-service hardware and video-consultation stack — the first-site incumbent will likely be defaulted to for the rollout.

signals.signal: Postbank's own product page defines exactly two Express Banking Digital Zone device types: a CASH device (cash withdrawal AND cash deposit plus cashless operations) and a KIOSK device (cashless only — statements, transfers, utility bills). Newly live functions include cash deposits in EUR to own accounts, outgoing EUR transfers domestically and to EEA countries, local municipal taxes to a list of municipalities, bill payment to 250+ merchants with standing-subscription setup, and e-receipts. Authentication is by bank card + PIN with no internet-banking registration required; the service is auto-enabled for all retail customers and on request for business customers. Non-Postbank cardholders may use a restricted subset (cash withdrawal, utility bills).
signals.source_name: Postbank — Digital Zones for Express Banking (product page)
signals.implies: Confirms a two-SKU self-service fleet with a distinct deposit-capable tier — the exact split the locator quantifies. Opening the estate to other banks' cardholders raises utilisation and strengthens the business case for recyclers. The 250+ biller catalogue and municipal tax rails add transaction-routing and monitoring load.
signals.followup: Ask for the CASH-vs-KIOSK unit split and the average cash-in volume per CASH device post-changeover.

signals.signal: Postbank launched a new end-to-end registration flow in Postbank App: a prospect completes onboarding in minutes and finishes with an active current account, a digital debit card, activated mobile and internet banking, and a chosen package programme — with no branch visit, no paper documents, no third-party app and no platform switching.
signals.implies: Live remote account opening implies a production identity-verification/eKYC stack plus downstream AML screening at retail volume. Printec digital onboarding/eKYC and AML/compliance are the direct fits; instant digital card issuance also touches HSM/key management.
signals.followup: Identify the eKYC/liveness vendor behind the flow and whether the same stack is planned for small-business onboarding.

signals.signal: Postbank was selected to the European Commission's EU AI Act Advisory Forum after a ~10-month selection from 700+ applicant organisations worldwide, and is the only bank from Central and Eastern Europe admitted. The Forum has ~170 members (alongside OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, IBM, Hugging Face, Qualcomm); first sitting 19/06/2026, two-year mandate.
signals.implies: Signals an unusually mature internal AI/data-governance function and a buyer that will make AI-Act conformity a procurement gate. Relevant to Printec AML/transaction-monitoring and any AI-assisted service layer, where model explainability and governance documentation become tender criteria rather than differentiators.
signals.followup: Check whether Postbank publishes an AI governance/model-risk framework that suppliers must map onto.

signals.signal: Postbank's 'AI Loan Administration: Turning Unstructured Emails into Automated Banking Operations' project — named contractors IBM watsonX and integrator IBS working with the bank's Loan Administration Department and Digital Transformation Division — moved from 2025 pilot to 2026 operational deployment and scaling. It uses generative AI, NLP, computer vision and RPA to extract client, IBAN, loan number, amount and operation type from thousands of free-text emails a month; the pilot reached 90% request-recognition accuracy. AI/customer-value function is led by Lina Varbanova.
signals.source_name: Digitalk.bg — Transform IT Awards '26 project profile
signals.implies: Names the incumbent AI stack (IBM watsonX) and the local integrator (IBS) inside Postbank's back office — the competitive set any Printec AI-adjacent or transaction-monitoring proposal will meet. Also shows the bank buys point solutions per process rather than a single platform, which leaves room for a specialist compliance/monitoring engine.
signals.followup: Confirm with a primary Postbank source whether watsonX is the enterprise-wide AI platform or a per-project choice.

signals.signal: EVA is Postbank's customer-facing digital assistant, self-hosted on the bank's own subdomain chatbot2.postbank.bg (loader at /api/js/chat.js) and now surfaced as a persistent 'Ask EVA' entry point in the top navigation for BOTH individual and business clients on the rebuilt postbank.bg. The same EVA brand is used by parent Eurobank in Greece ('Ψηφιακή βοηθός EVA'). Per a bank-sourced November-2025 press briefing, an EVA AI Voice Bot was to begin handling call-centre calls 24/7 from the start of 2026, alongside two internal AI development centres, 12 AI projects fully implemented plus 8 in progress, a combined effect of 105,000+ employee-hours, 420,000+ hours of customer time saved, and 95%+ of transactions executed online.
signals.source_name: Postbank site chrome (postbank.bg) + Economic.bg briefing on Postbank's 100+ AI projects
signals.implies: EVA is a group asset being pushed to the front of every channel, and the voice extension moves it into the contact centre. For Printec this is context rather than a direct opening — but a 24/7 AI voice front door plus a growing self-service estate is exactly the configuration where remote assistance / video-teller and managed-services propositions attach.
signals.likelihood: Voice bot slated live from early 2026; not independently confirmed in-window
signals.followup: Find a 2026 primary Postbank statement confirming EVA AI Voice Bot is live and its call-deflection rate; the November-2025 figures are pre-window and must not be carried forward as current.

signals.signal: From 14/08/2026 Postbank removed dual BGN/EUR display across Postbank App, Postbank Web and ONE wallet; balances, transactions, transfers, fees, commissions and statements now show in EUR only. The bank explicitly warned customers using Postbank Web statements for automated processing, import or integration to review and adapt those processes.
signals.implies: The euro-changeover programme closes in Bulgaria; screens, receipts and statement formats have just been re-cut across channels. With the changeover cost behind it, the bank's remaining cash-cycle lever is deposit automation — reinforcing the 275-machine white space above.
signals.followup: Confirm the equivalent dual-display end-date on ATM and self-service terminal screens, which may lag the digital channels.

signals.signal: Moody's Ratings affirmed Postbank's long-term deposit rating at A3 and long-term issuer rating at Baa2, stable outlook. Cited metrics: equity to risk-weighted assets 22.1% at end-2025, net profit to assets 1.7%, predominantly retail-deposit funding, and a substantial buffer above minimum MREL. The stable outlook reflects expected maintenance of these metrics over 12-18 months. Rating also factors a high probability of support from majority owner Eurobank S.A.
signals.implies: Capital headroom of this order means network-modernisation capex is not balance-sheet constrained; a well-capitalised, consistently profitable buyer is a sound counterparty for a multi-year managed-services or fleet-refresh contract.
signals.followup: Pull the full Moody's credit opinion for any comment on cost-to-income or efficiency programmes touching the branch network.

coverage_notes: Fresh run (no checkpoint existed). Primary-first: went to the bank's own newly rebuilt site (postbank.bg was re-platformed since the last run — new IA, new URL scheme, and a much shorter news archive), the legacy content host content.postbank.bg, the Express Banking product page, and the parent's IR sites. The single most valuable find was that the LEGACY locator at content.postbank.bg/Contacts/Network is fully server-rendered with machine-readable per-site flags (data-types="|isATM|isATMWithDeposit|", isBranch, isSelfServiceZone, isSSZ24H, isSpecializedCenter, isPriorityDesk) — this is a reusable, no-JS route to Postbank fleet counts every run and should be added to the source catalogue. Counts at 27/08/2026: 668 records, 501 ATM (226 deposit-capable), 167 branches, 154 self-service zones, 137 of them 24/7. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the English mirror at content.postbank.bg/en/Contacts/Network returns FEWER records (634 total, 467 ATM, 212 deposit-capable) while branch-side counts match exactly — the Bulgarian feed is the fuller one and is what I report; anyone re-pulling must use the BG URL or the ATM count will be understated by ~34. Baseline reconciliation: the 30/07/2026 figure of 498/225 is confirmed as the right order of magnitude and has moved to 501/226. Search angles varied across Bulgarian and English, bank newsroom, product pages, locator data, parent-group IR, credit-rating news, and Bulgarian IT/business trade press; the search-engine budget for the session was exhausted mid-run so the second half was done entirely by direct URL fetching and link-walking from primary pages. Genuine gaps: (a) no H1-2026 segment disclosure for Bulgaria obtained (see access issues); (b) BNB sector-level ATM/POS counts not obtained, so Postbank's 501 ATMs are not benchmarked against the national fleet this run; (c) no independent 2026 confirmation that EVA AI Voice Bot actually went live — the only figures available are from a November-2025 press briefing and are explicitly flagged Low and pre-window; (d) no tender or procurement notice found for self-service equipment.
access_issues: 1) www.postbank.bg is fronted by Imperva/Incapsula and the NEW locations page (https://www.postbank.bg/en/about-us/contacts/locations/) returns only page chrome to HTTP fetch — the map payload is not in any served JS bundle and no /api/ path could be guessed (tried /api/locations/, /en/api/locations/, /api/v1/locations/, /api/branches/, /api/atms/, /api/offices/, all 404). Escalation to Claude-in-Chrome was ATTEMPTED and FAILED: the Chrome extension is not connected in this session. WORKAROUND FOUND AND USED: the legacy host https://content.postbank.bg/Contacts/Network serves the full network list server-rendered with a desktop User-Agent — no JS, no browser needed. 2) www.eurobankholdings.gr behaves as an SPA to plain fetch: /el/omilos/grafeio-tupou/etairiki-anakoinosi-30-07-2026 (the H1-2026 results corporate announcement, dated 30/07/2026 and visible in the homepage feed) and every other deep path return an identical 144,076-byte shell, so the release PDF could not be retrieved. 3) www.eurobank.gr IR index (/en/group/investor-relations/financial-results, and ?pg=2) is stale — it lists nothing after Nine Months 2025 (30/10/2025); the 2026 result pages do not exist at the expected /financial-results-pages/first-half-2026 or /first-quarter-2026 slugs (both 404). 4) www.bnb.bg returns a soft-error page ('Несъществуващ адрес') for /statistics/stpaymentsystem/index.htm, /PaymentSystem/PSPaymentOversight/PSPOStatistics/index.htm and /Statistics/StPaymentSystem/index.htm even with a desktop User-Agent, and its own sitemap page exposes no payment-statistics links, so BNB card/terminal statistics were not reached. 5) The session's WebSearch budget (200/200) was exhausted partway through, so no further keyword discovery was possible; the remainder was link-walking and direct fetches. No source was silently dropped.
